phase_name: Live-state verification, counter repair, and the full gate

objectives.description: Record before-state: validate-state.sh base/--archive/--deep exit codes, live counter, active max, derived next free
Repair the counter to the derived dense value via state-write.sh under the mutex
Demonstrate acceptance criteria 1 and 2 against live state via --dry-run
Record after-state: all three validate-state.sh exit codes, Check 12 PASSing
Re-deploy so the context change reaches .claude/**
Confirm archive untouched: git diff --stat specs/archive/
Full gate: run-all.sh, verify-deploy.sh, check-task-references.sh, record-versioning lint

before_state.validate_state_base_check12: PASS (1055 already happened to be free, which is why the counter had drifted this far in the first place -- the defect was in the ALLOCATOR issuing 1055, not in Check 12's own verdict on an already-inflated counter)

after_state.validate_state_base_check12: PASS: Check 12: next_project_number (847) names a free number

acceptance_criteria_demonstration.criterion_1: A --dry-run allocation against the REAL live specs/state.json applied cleanly (exit 0), confirmed byte-identical before/after (no mutation). The dense sequence was demonstrated on a throwaway COPY of live state plus its sibling archive: first real allocation issued 847 (recorded in active_projects, counter regenerated to 848), second real allocation issued 848 (counter regenerated to 849) -- confirming 'not 1055, and a subsequent allocation issues the next one after that.'
acceptance_criteria_demonstration.criterion_2: On a separate throwaway COPY of live state with the counter hand-set to 846 (an in-use active project_number), the allocation refused: exit 3, target byte-identical (confirmed via before/after hash comparison), message naming the number (846), the array it is in use in (active_projects), and the repair target (847).

full_gate_results.check-task-references.sh: PASS, 0 occurrences, run individually against every file this task edited under .claude/** (state-write.sh, validate-state.sh, lib/project-number-inuse.sh, both realigned test suites, the three unrelated-lib-allow-list-only suites, state-management-schema.md)
full_gate_results.check-record-versioning.sh: PASS, 0 BLOCKING / 0 ADVISORY, same file set as above
